title: Tracecat 1.0.0-beta.53-rc.1
body_markdown:
## Case management


- feat(cases): Add filtered case aggregation ([#3419](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3419) )
- feat(cases): Aggregate cases by dropdowns and tags ([#3443](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3443) )
- feat(cases): Add case aggregation action ([#3444](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3444) )
- fix(ui+cases): Drop horizontal scroll in linked rows tables ([#3445](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3445) )
- fix(ui+cases): Thin hover scrollbars on linked rows grids ([#3446](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3446) )


## Tables


- feat(tables): Add table row aggregation action ([#3418](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3418) )


## Agents


- feat(agents): Grant tools declared by attached skills ([#3324](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3324) )
- feat(ui): Edit skill tool metadata with a picker ([#3325](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3325) )
- fix(agents): Avoid fatal LLM errors during proxy shutdown ([#3439](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3439) )
- fix(agents+docs): Expose case and table aggregation actions ([#3450](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3450) )


## Integrations


- feat(integrations): Add Vercel Security firewall templates ([#3449](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3449) )


## Engine


- fix(engine): Raise executor payload limit default to 5 GiB ([#3441](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3441) )
- fix(engine): Preserve registry tool timeout attribution ([#3452](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3452) )
- fix(engine): Preserve cancellation while returning workflow results ([#3456](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3456) )


## API


- fix(api): Skip denied Temporal search attribute registration ([#3426](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3426) )


## Infrastructure


- infra: Drop platform tracing from Fargate ([#3403](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3403) )


## Observability


- fix(logging): Identify Temporal activity timeouts in Sentry ([#3421](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3421) )
- fix(logging): Capture platform failures at their source ([#3428](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3428) )
- fix(logging): Preserve registry discovery crash diagnostics ([#3459](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3459) )


**Full changelog** :[1.0.0-beta.52...1.0.0-beta.53-rc.1](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/compare/1.0.0-beta.52...1.0.0-beta.53-rc.1)
